golden_facts.text: Switching the app language from English to Spanish makes the History tab show 'No workouts yet'
Switching the language back to English restores the history display
The web dashboard shows the workout data correctly, so no data is deleted
The issue reproduces on at least two devices (Pixel 8 phone and Galaxy Tab tablet)

extracted_facts.text: After changing the Meridian app language from English to Spanish in Settings, the History tab shows "No workouts yet" instead of the user's existing workout history
Switching the app language back to English restores the workout history
The workout data is not deleted; the issue is display/retrieval only and underlying data remains intact
The web dashboard displays the workout data correctly the entire time
The affected app is the Meridian fitness mobile app
The issue is reproduced on a Pixel 8 phone
The issue is reproduced on a Galaxy Tab tablet
The issue reproduces every time (100% reproducible per reporter)
